line: Ideas with a pitch, a status and a gut rating

summary.message: Capture ideas quickly and see the best ones first: each has a one-line pitch, an optional link, tags, a status from raw to shipped, a 1–5 rating and dated notes.
summary.keeps: Ideas with their pitch, link, tags, status, rating and notes.

Deleting an idea or a note is marked destructive
findings.detail: An agent has to ask you before it can.
